bankingSetup.title: Enable Banking
bankingSetup.legacy: Global legacy access active · existing connections only
bankingSetup.privateIntro: FullWorth uses your own Enable Banking access for your own bank accounts.
bankingSetup.privateBoundary: For private testing with family or friends, each person sets up their own Enable Banking account, application and linked accounts. A public or shared banking application requires an agreement with Enable Banking.
bankingSetup.ack: I am setting this up for my own accounts.
bankingSetup.createApp: Create an AIS application in the Enable Banking Control Panel. For your own real accounts choose Production, then activate restricted mode by linking your own accounts.
bankingSetup.keyHint: The private key is uploaded once, verified server-side and stored encrypted. FullWorth never shows it again.
bankingSetup.missingCredentials: Application ID and PEM file are required.
bankingSetup.complete: The Enable Banking access is ready.
bankingSetup.activateRestricted: The Production application is still inactive. Use “Activate by linking accounts” in the Control Panel for your own accounts, then recheck it here.
bankingSetup.removeConfirm: Remove the Enable Banking access from FullWorth? Existing bank connections must be disconnected first.
bankingSetup.businessNotice: Business accounts are technically supported. Under Restricted Production, business use is only intended for evaluation or transition under Enable Banking's standard terms; ongoing business use requires an appropriate agreement.
bankingSetup.bankNotFound: The bank was not found in the current Enable Banking institution list.
bankingSetup.bankRenamedHint: The bank name may have changed. Please select the current bank.
bankingSetup.accountIdentifiersHint: Optional: one IBAN per line. Other identifiers use SCHEME|IDENTIFICATION|ISSUER, e.g. BBAN|123456. Without a restriction, the bank flow handles account selection.
bankingSetup.accountIdentifiersMissing: Enter at least one valid IBAN or SCHEME|IDENTIFICATION.
bankingSetup.setupChoiceHint: FullWorth can create the Enable Banking application automatically through the official Control Panel API, or you can set it up manually.
bankingSetup.automaticHint: FullWorth generates the RSA key, signs you in once through an Enable Banking email link and registers the application.
bankingSetup.manualHint: Create the application in the Enable Banking Control Panel and import its application ID and PEM file.
bankingSetup.automaticExplain: Automatic setup uses a one-time passwordless Enable Banking sign-in. Control Panel tokens are not stored.
bankingSetup.emailSent: Enable Banking sent a sign-in link to your email. Open the link. FullWorth will then register the application automatically.
bankingSetup.waitingForEmail: Waiting for the Enable Banking sign-in link …
bankingSetup.verifyingApp: Verifying and securely storing the application …
bankingSetup.autoComplete: The Enable Banking application was set up automatically.
bankingSetup.autoExpired: Automatic setup expired. Start it again.
bankingSetup.automaticSecurity: The private RSA key stays in FullWorth and is stored encrypted after successful verification.

onboarding.title: Set up FullWorth
onboarding.intro: Set up your personal access now so FullWorth can use bank data and AI features.
onboarding.optional: Both steps are optional. You can skip them and add, change, or reconnect them later at any time in Settings.
onboarding.aiText: Choose Codex / ChatGPT, your own OpenAI API key, or a custom OpenAI-compatible endpoint.
onboarding.bankText: Set up Enable Banking if you want FullWorth to synchronize accounts and transactions automatically.
onboarding.done: Setup complete. All access settings can still be changed later in Settings.
